title: GlusterFS Heal Pending

annotations.description: GlusterFS has entries pending heal for more than 5 minutes.

_comment: Depends on scripts/gluster-heal-check.sh populating the textfile collector. Note: this script was patched to emit a separate gluster_check_failed metric after the underlying `gluster` command itself failed during a glusterd restart and produced a false split-brain positive — see docs/incident-reports/03-failover-testing-and-boot-races.md.
